title: QUANTITY OF MARIGOLD CARNIVAL ...
reason: Sizeable group of about twelve marigold carnival glass pieces in good visible condition, worth a look as a lot, but a common colour and nothing is marked.
findings: Three photos of about twelve pieces of marigold carnival glass. Vases and mugs: two ribbed tankard mugs and one tall flared vase, all with gilt rims and a marigold to clear fade (looks like a later, mid 20th century type), a swung vase, and a small ruffled vase. Bowls: a stemmed ruffled comport on a clear stem, a footed ruffled bowl on a clear pedestal foot, a large deep fruit bowl with arched panels filled with diamond lattice, and four smaller ruffled or ribbed bowls (one with a feather or peacock-tail style pattern, one with an oval rose-like pattern, one plain ribbed round bowl, one ruffled scroll pattern). Bases are not shown, so no trademark (for example a Northwood or Fenton mark) could be checked; pattern names are guesses from appearance only. Title is accurate.
condition: No chips, cracks or loss of iridescence visible in the photos, but rims and bases are not shown close up. Light gilt rim wear on the mugs and tall vase.
rescore_note: About twelve pieces of common marigold carnival glass (ruffled bowls, comports, swung vase, plus later gilt-rim tankards); good iridescence and no damage seen, but unmarked and a cheap colour, so lower part of the $80 to 200 band. (no web price check)
